call_points.text: FY27 volume growth guidance maintained at 6-8%; EBITDA per tonne guidance raised to ₹24,000-25,000 from ₹19,000-21,000.
call_points.versus_prior: EBITDA/tonne raised from ₹19,000-21,000; volume guidance unchanged

call_points.text: Freight rates on exports more than doubled, feeding into CIF prices and partly explaining the realisation jump.
Mexico EPC project is contributing service income and remains on track for commercialisation within 12 months.
EPC service income is a separate segment, not part of performance products, and recognition will be completed by end of FY27.
Specialty share of mix fell to about 34% from 40% because performance products grew faster, lifting the denominator.
New products launched (SimpliX, Biosurf, Lumithic, Everbond) are targeted to contribute over 5% of total revenue by 2030.
Beauty and Wellness inorganic acquisition work is progressing but no announcement yet; management will not overpay for fit.
AMET Q1 was hit by about seven weeks of supply disruption in Egypt; demand is intact and management expects AMET to return to growth this year.
Q1FY27 volume growth is guided at the higher end of 6% to 8%.
EBITDA per metric tonne for Q1FY27 is expected at the higher end of ₹19,000 to ₹21,000.
India volumes grew 8% year-on-year in Q4, driven by 27% growth in specialty.

operating_notes.text: FY26 exceptional item of ₹11.88 Cr is past service cost on the new labour codes: gratuity ₹9.66 Cr and leave encashment ₹2.22 Cr, booked in Q3FY26.
Other income includes ₹22.03 Cr in FY26 (₹4.56 Cr in Q4FY26) of fair-value gain on preference shares mandatorily measured at FVTPL.
GIDC order dated 5 October 2024 to vacate land (carrying value ₹72.88 Cr) is stayed and sub judice; no provision considered necessary.
Specialty segment grew 27% annually in FY26, consistent with Strategy 2030.
Oleochemical feedstock prices moved from an average of USD 2,800 per tonne to a high of USD 3,300 per tonne in Q1 before correcting below USD 2,500 per tonne towards end-June.
Fatty alcohol prices were at about INR 2,700-2,800 per tonne in India, with management expecting them to move sideways between INR 2,600 and INR 2,800.
AMET volumes fell 4% YoY but rose 19% sequentially after about seven weeks of Egypt supply disruption in Q1.

timeline.summary: U. Shekhar, Gopalkrishnan Ramakrishnan, Shashikant Rayappa Shanbhag, and Siddharth Patil declared no encumbrance on Galaxy Surfactants shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on April 1, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,314.7 Cr (+14.8% YoY), net profit ₹62.43 Cr (-17.7% YoY).
Galaxy Surfactants Limited’s **Niranjan Ketkar** uploaded the audio recording of its May 15, 2026, investor concall on Q4 FY2026 performance.
On May 21, 2026, Galaxy Surfactants published the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call.

On its 14 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Galaxy Surfactants reported record quarterly EBITDA of ₹252.5 Cr (₹35,458 per tonne) and raised FY27 EBITDA-per-tonne guidance to ₹24,000-25,000 while keeping volume growth at 6-8%.
